assets.name: Announcement-aware historical circulating shares
assets.source: quant local lake; QMT xtdata Capital history
assets.schema_and_units: qmt_code, symbol, exchange, m_timetag effective date, m_anntime announcement date, circulating_capital in shares, restrict_circulating_capital, freeFloatCapital, source

quality_evidence.selection_policy: Require both effective date and announcement date no later than decision_at; select the latest effective date and then latest announcement revision; nonpositive values fail closed.

set hard_valid=false whenever circulating shares are unknown or nonpositive
